{{uv|DF2012}}
DFConfig is a graphical utility for altering [[d_init.txt]] settings. A standalone version can be downloaded from {{dffd|2563|here}}; the main {{f|59933|forum thread}} is here. The utility is integrated into the [[Utility:Lazy Newb Pack|Lazy Newb Pack]]&mdash;in fact, it's what the pack is built on&mdash;but users looking to "build their own" distributions can use the standalone version.
